heading: 求醫療病

source.scanTranscription: 朔弦望　忌求醫療病　按朔為日月同度弦為近一遠三望為日月相對猶建破平收之義也故忌療病

correction.reason: The abbreviated inventory token 朔望日 omitted 弦 from the explicit 卷十 clause; scan n216/217 confirms it. Keep token as compatibility name, record all four phases in the scope.
